Shockwaves around the world as Jensen Huang exits Nvidia but what happens next for Nvidia in the gaming space? It's all guesswork to be honest, but this Direct's all-British panel does have some thoughts on the matter. GTA 6 is confirmed (again) as a 30fps title with PS5 Pro features finally revealed, while Microsoft provides a way for Xbox One users to play. Tom gets to grips with the Witcher 3 Switch 2's latest patch, while old gripes about Xbox Series S once again resurface.
